senses.gloss: m. (part. pass. of פְּנַק) brought up in wealth, delicate, fastidious.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:3">Targ. Prov. IV, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:5">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ כולי האי</he> is he used to such comforts?—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 84a:12">B. Kam. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>איכא איניש דמ׳ וכ׳</he> one man is delicate and feels pain more intensely, another is hardened &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>מְפַנְקִין</he>, <he>מְפַנְקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:4">Targ. Is. XLIV, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 4a">Ḥag. 4ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>לאתויי מ׳</he> to include delicate persons (that do not walk barefooted).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 47:8">Targ. Is. XLVII, 8</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="M02228"><he>מְפַנְקָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02227"><he>מְפַנְקָאתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 4:3">Targ. Lam. IV, 3</cite>.
